name: core-runtime-system-object-values-depth
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves Glade-local Object, Request, and Savepoint value behavior only; zero Salesforce parity is claimed.

source.content: @isTest private class SystemObjectValuesDepthTest { @isTest static void provesObjectRequestAndSavepointValues() { Request request = Request.getCurrent(); Request clonedRequest = (Request)request.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(request, clonedRequest); System.assertEquals(request.getRequestId(), clonedRequest.getRequestId()); System.assertEquals(request.getQuiddity(), clonedRequest.getQuiddity()); Object objectValue = (Object)request; System.assert(objectValue.equals(objectValue)); System.assert(!objectValue.equals(clonedRequest)); System.assert(!objectValue.equals(null)); System.assertEquals(objectValue.hashCode(), objectValue.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, objectValue.toString()); Savepoint first = Database.setSavepoint(); Savepoint second = Database.setSavepoint(); System.assert(first.equals(first)); System.assert(!first.equals(second)); System.assert(!first.equals(null)); System.assertEquals(first.hashCode(), first.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, first.toString()); } }
